earth_sites.name: Mount Etna (Cisternazza / Piano del Lago)
earth_sites.citation: Wedler et al. (2017) ROBEX & Schuster et al. (2020) ARCHES lunar analog rover campaigns, Cisternazza crater rim, Mt. Etna (OSM verified, ~2565 m, 37°43'33"N, 15°00'30"E).

validation.rationale_tr: ARCHES/ROBEX kampanyaları Cisternazza yamacını doğrudan Ay rover otonom mobilite sahası olarak doğrulamıştır.
validation.rationale_en: ARCHES and ROBEX field campaigns directly validate Mt. Etna as a lunar autonomous rover mobility testbed.

earth_sites.name: Atacama Desert (Yungay Station)
earth_sites.citation: Navarro-González et al. (2003, Science 302:1018-1021) & Warren-Rhodes et al. (2006), Yungay hyperarid core (24°06'18.6"S, 70°01'55.6"W).

validation.rationale_tr: Zoë otonom sürüş testleri düz hiperkurak zemin mobilitesini doğrular; dik krater duvarı eğimlerini temsil etmez.
validation.rationale_en: Zoë rover autonomous traverse validates flat hyperarid mobility but does not represent steep crater-wall slopes.

earth_sites.name: Haughton Impact Crater (Devon Island)
earth_sites.citation: Osinski et al. (2005, Meteoritics & Planetary Science 40:1759-1776) & Lee (Haughton-Mars Project), Devon Island (75°22'N, 89°41'W).

validation.rationale_tr: Haughton-Mars Projesi çarpma krateri içinde doğrudan rover, sondaj ve EVA mobilite operasyonlarını yürütmüştür.
validation.rationale_en: The Haughton-Mars Project conducts rover, drilling and EVA mobility tests directly inside an Arctic impact crater.

earth_sites.name: Mauna Loa North Flank (HI-SEAS Basalt Field, Hawaii)
earth_sites.citation: Binsted et al. (2016) HI-SEAS lunar/Mars analog habitat & Bleacher et al. (2017, JVGR 342:1-10), Mauna Loa northern flank tholeiitic basalt (~2500 m, 19°36'10"N, 155°29'16"W).

validation.rationale_tr: HI-SEAS görevleri toleyitik bazalt lav akıntıları üzerinde doğrudan jeolojik yürüyüş ve saha operasyonlarını doğrular.
validation.rationale_en: HI-SEAS missions validate astronaut EVA and geological field operations on tholeiitic basalt lava flows.
validation.source_label: Shiro et al. (2022), Planet. Space Sci.

earth_sites.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys (Wright Valley, Antarctica)
earth_sites.citation: Marchant & Head (2007, Icarus 192:187-222) & Levy et al. (2009), Wright Valley cold hyperarid polar desert Mars/lunar ice analog (77°31'S, 161°51'E).

validation.rationale_tr: Birincil literatürde soğuk-çöl permafrost/termal rejim analoğudur (termal v1'de askıda); v1 aktif eksenlerde kesin beklenti yoktur.
validation.rationale_en: Primary analogue for cold-desert permafrost/thermal regimes (suspended in v1); no confirmed mobility/surface claim.

earth_sites.name: Lanzarote Tinguatón / Timanfaya (ESA PANGAEA, Canary Islands)
earth_sites.citation: Sauro et al. (2020, Earth-Science Reviews 208:103288) & Bessone et al. (2018), ESA PANGAEA astronaut geological training campaign, Lanzarote basaltic fissure field (29°00'54"N, 13°42'54"W).

validation.rationale_tr: ESA PANGAEA astronot eğitimi taze bazaltik lav/skorya arazisini saha mobilite ve operasyon analoğu olarak kullanır.
validation.rationale_en: ESA PANGAEA astronaut training uses fresh basaltic lava fields as a planetary surface mobility and operations analogue.

earth_sites.name: Meteor Crater / Barringer Impact Crater (Arizona)
earth_sites.citation: Kring (2007, LPI Contribution 1355) & Shoemaker (1963), Barringer Meteor Crater Apollo & Artemis astronaut training site (35°01'38"N, 111°01'21"W).

validation.rationale_tr: Kring rehberi ve Shoemaker (1959) basit krater duvar eğimi ve Apollo eğitimi için Meteor Crater'ı standart referans kurar.
validation.rationale_en: Kring guidebook and Shoemaker (1959) establish simple crater wall slopes and Apollo field training at Meteor Crater.

earth_sites.name: Craters of the Moon Lava Field (Idaho)
earth_sites.citation: Hughes et al. (2019, JVGR) & NASA FINESSE / BASALT planetary analog field campaigns, Craters of the Moon National Monument basalt flows (43°27'42"N, 113°33'45"W).

validation.rationale_tr: NASA BASALT ve FINESSE programları lav akıntısı pürüzlülüğü üzerinde insan/robotik yürüyüş operasyonlarını doğrulamıştır.
validation.rationale_en: NASA BASALT and FINESSE select Craters of the Moon lava flows for human and robotic planetary field mobility.

earth_sites.name: Svalbard Bockfjorden (Sverrefjellet AMASE, Norway)
earth_sites.citation: Steele et al. (2011, Astrobiology 11) & Amundsen et al. (2012), Arctic Mars Analog Svalbard Expedition (AMASE), Sverrefjellet Quaternary basalt volcano, Bockfjorden (79°25'41"N, 13°23'06"E).

validation.rationale_tr: Arktik permafrost belgelenmiştir; ancak rover mobilite veya broadband albedo kalibrasyonu için birincil yayın doğrulanamadı.
validation.rationale_en: Arctic permafrost is documented, but no primary rover mobility or broadband albedo calibration study is verified.

earth_sites.name: Lunar Crater Volcanic Field (Black Rock Flow, Nevada)
earth_sites.citation: Greeley et al. (1972, NASA SP-315) & Valentine et al. (2017, Geosphere 13:391-438), Lunar Crater Volcanic Field Apollo & rover test site, Nevada (38°23'02"N, 116°04'05"W).

validation.rationale_tr: AIRSAR radar deneylerinde yüzey pürüzlülüğü (roughness) kestirimi için birincil yer-gerçeği kalibrasyon sahasıdır.
validation.rationale_en: Primary ground-truth site for AIRSAR surface roughness estimation across maar craters and volcanic basalt flows.

earth_sites.name: Karacadağ Shield Volcano (Kollubaba / Lav Platosu)
earth_sites.citation: Lustrino et al. (2010, Lithos 117:135-151), Keskin et al. (2012) & Ekici et al. (2014), Karacadağ shield volcano summit plateau (37°40'12"N, 39°49'48"E).

earth_sites.name: Karacadağ NE Flank (Ovabağ Low-Slope Basalt Flow, Diyarbakır)
earth_sites.citation: Ekici et al. (2014, Geodinamica Acta 26:3-4) & Lustrino et al. (2012), Quaternary Ovabağ plateau alkali-olivine basalt flows on NE Karacadağ shield (37°47'06"N, 40°01'30"E).

earth_sites.name: Kula Volcanic Geopark (Divlit Scoria Cone & ʻAʻā Basalt, Manisa)
earth_sites.citation: Ersoy et al. (2010, JVGR 190:291-306) & Aldanmaz et al. (2015), Kula Quaternary intraplate alkali basaltic cinder cones and blocky lava flows (38°33'58"N, 28°38'10"E).

earth_sites.name: Tendürek Shield Volcano (Çaldıran Basalt Lava Apron, Ağrı-Van)
earth_sites.citation: Lebedev et al. (2016, Petrology 24:127-163) & Yılmaz et al. (1998, JVGR 85:173-210), Tendürek low-angle shield volcano Holocene basaltic-trachyandesitic lava flows (39°19'12"N, 43°55'12"E).

earth_sites.name: Mount Erciyes (Koçdağ SE Flank Basalt-Andesite Plateau, Kayseri)
earth_sites.citation: Şen et al. (2003, JVGR 125:225-246) & Friedrichs et al. (2020), Erciyes stratovolcano southeastern flank monogenetic vents and lava domes (38°30'18"N, 35°32'06"E).

earth_sites.name: Mount Hasan / Hasandağı (NW Flank Basalt-Andesite Apron, Aksaray)
earth_sites.citation: Deniel et al. (1998, JVGR 87:275-302) & Aydar & Gourgaud (1998), Hasandağı Quaternary pyroclastic and basaltic-andesitic fan deposits (38°10'30"N, 34°07'12"E).

earth_sites.name: Acıgöl-Nevşehir Caldera (Güneydağ Maar & Tephra Ring, Nevşehir)
earth_sites.citation: Druitt et al. (1995, J. Geol. Soc. London 152:655-667) & Schmitt et al. (2011), Acıgöl-Nevşehir Pleistocene caldera maar craters and tephra ring plains (38°31'30"N, 34°33'18"E).

earth_sites.name: Cappadocia Ignimbrite Plateau (Kavak / Göreme Tuff Tableland, Nevşehir)
earth_sites.citation: Le Pennec et al. (1994, JVGR 63:59-87) & Aydar et al. (2012, Bull. Volcanol. 74:739-762), Neogene Cappadocian Ignimbrite Province welded tuff plateau (38°39'00"N, 34°51'36"E).

earth_sites.name: Tuz Gölü Basin (Southern Evaporite Marginal Flat, Aksaray)
earth_sites.citation: Çiner et al. (2021) & Kashima (2002, Catena 48:3-20), Tuz Gölü closed-basin subaerial halite/gypsum evaporite salt flat margin, Central Anatolia (38°33'00"N, 33°37'12"E).

earth_sites.name: Lake Salda Onshore Terrace (Hydromagnesite/Ultramafic Shore, Burdur)
earth_sites.citation: Horgan et al. (2020, Icarus 339:113526) & Russell et al. (1999, J. Geol. Soc. 156:869-888) — ALREADY ESTABLISHED IN LITERATURE as NASA Perseverance Jezero Crater carbonate/hydromagnesite Mars analog (not a newly proposed site; southwestern onshore ultramafic/hydromagnesite terrace, 37°30'54"N, 29°38'06"E).

earth_sites.name: Askja / Holuhraun Basalt Sand & Lava Plain (Dyngjusandur, Iceland)
earth_sites.citation: Pedersen et al. (2017, JVGR 340:155-170) & Greeley et al. (2000), Holuhraun / Dyngjusandur high-latitude glaciovolcanic basaltic lava and aeolian sand plain (64°52'48"N, 16°49'12"W).

earth_sites.name: Harrat Rahat Volcanic Field (Northern Basalt Plateau, Saudi Arabia)
earth_sites.citation: Camp & Roobol (1989, GSA Bulletin 101:71-95) & Downs et al. (2018), Northern Harrat Rahat continental intraplate alkali basalt field (24°19'48"N, 39°46'12"E).

earth_sites.name: Sierra del Pinacate Volcanic Field (El Elegante Maar Rim, Sonora, Mexico)
earth_sites.citation: Gutmann (2002, GSA Special Paper 365) & Greeley et al. (1985), Pinacate arid basaltic maar crater south rim (Crater El Elegante, OSM verified, 31°50'25"N, 113°23'42"W).

earth_sites.name: Puna de Atacama (Campo de Piedra Pómez Ignimbrite & Basalt, Argentina)
earth_sites.citation: de Silva et al. (2010, Geology 38:219-222) & Bridges et al. (2015, JGR Planets), Puna de Atacama hyperarid high-altitude (~3300 m) yardang ignimbrite and basalt field (26°34'12"S, 67°26'24"W).

earth_sites.name: Deccan Traps Flood Basalt Plateau (Panchgani Tableland, India)
earth_sites.citation: Self et al. (2006, EPSL 248:518-532) & Jay & Widdowson (2008), Deccan Traps Wai Subgroup tholeiitic flood basalt tableland (17°55'26"N, 73°48'18"E).

earth_sites.name: Harrat Ash Shaam Basalt Desert (Badia Black Basalt Plateau, Jordan)
earth_sites.citation: Ibrahim et al. (2006) & Shaw et al. (2003, J. Petrology 44:1657-1679), Harrat Ash Shaam arid intraplate basaltic boulder field (32°13'12"N, 37°09'00"E).

earth_sites.name: Potrillo Volcanic Field (Kilbourne Hole Maar & Basalt Rim, New Mexico)
earth_sites.citation: Seeger et al. (2019) & Padovani & Carter (1977), Kilbourne Hole phreatomagmatic maar and Aden basalt field, Rio Grande Rift (31°58'05"N, 106°58'19"W).

earth_sites.name: Qaidam Basin (Dalangtan Hyperarid Evaporite Flat, China)
earth_sites.citation: Xiao et al. (2017, ESR 164:84-101) & Anglés & Li (2017, JGR Planets), Dalangtan high-altitude (~2700 m) hyperarid sulfate/halite evaporite flats, Qaidam Basin (38°28'48"N, 91°27'00"E).

earth_sites.name: Karapınar Volcanic Field (Meke Maar & Scoria Apron, Konya)
earth_sites.citation: Keller (1974, Bull. Volcanol. 38:378-396) & Reid et al. (2017, JVGR 338:1-13), Karapınar Quaternary basaltic maar and scoria cone field, Konya Basin (37°40'30"N, 33°39'54"E).

earth_sites.name: Mount Süphan (Lower Adilcevaz Basalt-Andesite Lava Apron, Bitlis)
earth_sites.citation: Özdemir et al. (2011, Lithos 127:68-85) & Yılmaz et al. (1998, JVGR 85:173-210), Mount Süphan southern basaltic-trachyandesitic lower apron ~6.9 km S of summit (~2233 m, 38°51'54"N, 42°49'48"E).

earth_sites.name: Nemrut Volcano (Tatvan Eastern Ignimbrite & Lava Flank, Bitlis)
earth_sites.citation: Çubukçu et al. (2012, JVGR 209-210:33-60) & Ulusoy et al. (2008), Nemrut Quaternary caldera eastern pyroclastic and pre-caldera lava apron (38°36'36"N, 42°18'36"E).

earth_sites.name: Mount Ararat / Ağrı Dağı (Western Basalt Lava Flank, Doğubayazıt)
earth_sites.citation: Yılmaz et al. (1998, JVGR 85:173-210) & Pearce et al. (1990, JVGR 44:189-229), Mount Ararat (Ağrı) lower western flank Quaternary basaltic lava flow above Doğubayazıt (~1764 m, 39°40'48"N, 44°08'24"E).

earth_sites.name: Payunia Volcanic Province (Pampa Negra Basalt & Lapilli Plain, Argentina)
earth_sites.citation: Søager et al. (2013, Chem. Geol. 349-350:36-53) & Hernando et al. (2014, JVGR 272:1-19), Payunia back-arc basaltic cinder cone and dark lapilli sheet, Mendoza (36°10'48"S, 69°10'48"W).

earth_sites.name: Altiplano-Puna Complex (Chajnantor High-Altitude Ignimbrite Plateau, Chile)
earth_sites.citation: Salisbury et al. (2011, GSA Bull. 123:821-840) & de Silva (1989, Geology 17:1102-1106), Chajnantor hyperarid high-altitude (~5050 m) dacitic-rhyodacitic ignimbrite tableland (23°01'23"S, 67°45'14"W).

earth_sites.name: Waw an Namus Volcano (Dark Basaltic Tephra Apron, Fezzan, Libya)
earth_sites.citation: Bardintzeff et al. (2012, Chemie der Erde 72:135-145) & Busrewil & Wadsworth (1983), Waw an Namus Saharan intraplate maar dark basaltic tephra apron (24°57'00"N, 17°45'36"E).

earth_sites.name: Tibesti Volcanic Massif (Tarso Voon Ignimbrite & Basalt Plateau, Chad)
earth_sites.citation: Permenter & Oppenheimer (2007, Bull. Volcanol. 69:609-626) & Gourgaud & Vincent (2004, JVGR 129:261-294), Tibesti intracontinental volcanic plateau, northern Chad (20°55'12"N, 17°16'48"E).

earth_sites.name: Michoacán-Guanajuato Field (Parícutin Basaltic-Andesite Flow, Mexico)
earth_sites.citation: Luhr & Simkin (1993) & Erlund et al. (2010, Bull. Volcanol. 72:347-363), Parícutin 1943-1952 basaltic-andesite lava field, Michoacán (19°29'35"N, 102°15'04"W).

earth_sites.name: Tolbachik Volcanic Massif (Basalt Scoria & Lava Plain, Kamchatka)
earth_sites.citation: Belousov et al. (2015, JVGR 307:22-37) & Fedotov et al. (1991), Tolbachik fissure eruption basaltic scoria cones and lava apron, Kamchatka (55°45'18"N, 160°17'42"E).

earth_sites.name: Kīlauea SW Rift Zone (Kaʻū Desert Basalt & Tephra Plain, Hawaii)
earth_sites.citation: Craddock et al. (2012, JGR Planets 117:E08009) & Schiffman et al. (2006, Geology 34:921-924), Kaʻū Desert acid-sulfate altered tholeiitic basalt and ash plain, Kīlauea (19°21'54"N, 155°20'06"W).

earth_sites.name: Tongariro Volcanic Centre (Rangipo Andesitic-Basaltic Tephra Plain, NZ)
earth_sites.citation: Donoghue et al. (1995, Bull. Volcanol. 57:563-576) & Hobden et al. (1999, J. Petrology 40:1965-1990), Rangipo high-altitude volcaniclastic andesitic-basaltic ring plain, Ruapehu-Tongariro (39°17'06"S, 175°43'12"E).

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Salda Lake Terrace (current)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: Adjacent shoreline fields/dry steppe in 1 km MOD11A2/500 m MCD43A3; summer S2 mostly bare dry soil (93.1%).

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Tuz Golu South Salt Flat (current)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: Shallow brine covers 26.8% of 1 km buffer (WC); S2 SCL=11 (17.6%) is bright halite crust false-positive, not snow.

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Svalbard Bockfjorden (current)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: Fjord water (15.5% WC / 29.8% S2) and Arctic tundra (43.1% WC) contaminate 1 km LST & 500 m albedo.

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Mount Suphan Apron (new approved: 38.8650, 42.8300)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: Dry highland steppe/fallow fields in WC (79.3% grass/scrub, 18.4% fallow crop), 99.8% bare in Sep S2.

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Meteor Crater Arizona (current)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: WC maps sparse Colorado Plateau desert scrub (41.9%); Aug S2 confirms 99.9% bare soil/ejecta reflectance.

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Mount Etna (applied Candidate 1 Cisternazza: 37.7257, 15.0084)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: Selected Candidate 1 (WC=99.4% bare tephra, 0.6% veg; summer S2 0% snow, Apr S2 0.3% snow, Feb S2 22.0% snow).

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Etna Candidate 1: Cisternazza (37.7257, 15.0084)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: Purest volcanic surface: WC=99.4% bare tephra, 0.6% veg; summer S2 0% snow; lowest Feb snow (22.0%).

mixed_pixel_audit.label: Etna Candidate 2: Piano del Lago W (37.7190, 14.9970)
mixed_pixel_audit.note: WC=96.7% bare tephra, 3.3% veg, summer S2 1.0-1.5% veg/0% snow; Feb 2024 winter S2 shows 53.1% snow.
